title: Gradual adoption of Optimize configuration suggestions with canary approvals and rollback gating
creator: Priya Kapoor
description:
Problem: Optimize suggestions (batching / KV caching / quantization toggles) can materially reduce cost but risk increasing p99 latency or causing quality regressions. We need an automated, low-risk way to apply recommendations to production with strong safety checks and an approval step when appropriate.

Goal: Build a gated, gradual apply flow for Optimize suggestions that: 1) automatically orchestras safe canaries; 2) runs lightweight canary validation against latency, cost, and quality probes; 3) supports configurable approval rules (auto-approve for low-risk changes, manual approval for higher-risk); 4) provides fast autonomous rollback on breach and human-readable audit trail.

Scope: Service-side rollout controller, canary selection heuristics, policy engine for approval gating, integration with Console for review/visibility, and automated rollback hooks wired into deployment executor. Not in scope: model training/evaluations beyond small prompt-set regressions run as part of canary validation.
acceptance_criteria: A rollout controller can apply an Optimize suggestion to a configurable small % (default 2%) of traffic as a canary and measure windows vs baseline
Canary validation runs a defined set of checks (p99 latency, cost_per_token, request_error_rate, eval_regression_rate) and returns pass/fail within 10 minutes
Policy engine evaluates suggestion metadata and decides auto-approve vs require-manual-approval according to rules (risk tags, potential cost delta, customer_scope)
Automated rollback triggers if any check crosses an operator-configured threshold and records a reversible action and reason in audit logs
Console shows per-rollout timeline, metrics, approval status, and link to related PRs/Runbook
End-to-end test: simulate a suggestion that improves cost by >= 18% but increases p99 latency by 10% and verify system blocks auto-apply and prompts manual approval
technical_notes: Canary selector: pick representative routes by traffic volume + model variant coverage; prefer routes with stable latency history for sensitive checks

Validation suite: (1) perf window (p50,p95,p99), (2) economic delta (tokens/second and cost_per_token), (3) functional evals (100 prompt seed set with embedding similarity / generation score), (4) error/failure rate

Gating thresholds: defaults: p99 +5% relative, error_rate +0.1% absolute, cost_delta -10% required to be considered beneficial. All thresholds configurable per-customer and per-project via policy profiles

Approval policy: rules expressed as ordered clauses (e.g., if scope==global && cost_delta>=20% && latency_delta<=2% => auto-apply; else require manual approval). Implement as simple rule-evaluator service (no external DSL initially)

Rollback: staged rollback that reverts config for affected hosts/slots and optionally pins the previous optimize profile; must complete revert within 120s for canary slice and schedule wider rollback if issue persists

Persistence: every rollout event + decisions persisted in rollout_events table with fields: rollout_id, suggestion_id, step, metric_snapshot, decision, actor (system or user), link_to_pr. (Serialize as JSON string in DB row)
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - experiments: run in internal sandbox and perf cluster for two weeks; collect baseline and build validation harness (1 week)
Phase 1 - canary pilot: enable controller for internal customers and small external beta accounts; default canary size 2% and step increments of 5% (1 week)
Phase 2 - policy tuning: tune auto-approve thresholds and mapping for low-risk suggestion types (2 weeks)
Phase 3 - wide rollout: enable auto-apply for low-risk rule matches and surface manual approvals in Console for others; monitor for 4 weeks before enabling on Dedicated tenants
Phase 4 - hardening: add audit export, SSO/SAML approval integration, and incident runbooks for rollback exercises
monitoring_checks: metric:cold_start_rate - detect increases due to new quantization kernels
metric:p99_latency - absolute and relative windowed comparison vs baseline
metric:cost_per_token - rolling 1h and instant bucket deltas
metric:eval_regression_rate - percent of seed prompts with degraded score beyond threshold
log:deployment_errors - parse for kernel OOMs, kv-miss storms, or codec errors
security_considerations: Approval actions must be auditable and require SSO identity; no secrets exposed during rollout traces
Policy engine config stored in KMS-backed encrypted store; edits require two-person review for cluster-wide default profiles
Canary validation does not send PII to external eval services; any external calls must be logged and authorized
testing_plan: Unit tests for policy evaluator, canary selector, and validation runner
Integration tests: simulated traffic replays against staging runtime to validate metric collection and rollback triggers
Chaos test: inject latency and error spikes during canary to assert automatic rollback paths
E2E test: prebuilt harness that runs a full suggestion lifecycle from suggestion creation to rollback or promotion
outstanding_risks: False negatives in lightweight evals could approve a regresssion; mitigated by conservative thresholds and manual review for higher-impact changes
Rollout controller complexity could add latency to apply paths; mitigate by async application where possible
Interaction with Dedicated customers' custom configs; need explicit opt-in or allow tenant-level policy overrides
